newsitem.title: JAPAN: Land tax debate important for Japan economy -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Land tax debate important for Japan economy -- MOF.

text.p: Government debate on the subject of land tax reform is important for the Japanese economy, Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday.

"If we are to presume that land prices have bottomed out, then debate within the government's tax research council will contribute to the effective use of land and help support the economy," he told a parliamentary budget committee.
Asked about taxes on securities, Mitsuzuka also said that Japan's securities transaction tax would have to be looked at in conjunction with the capital gains tax.
Construction Minister Shizuka Kamei told the same parliamentary committee that it is important for the government to buy land to stimulate the economy.

Kamei said; "In the past, the government used public investment funds to buy land and thus supported economic recovery. Giving consideration to the economy, it is important for the government to buy land for public use."
